title: How Long the Property Credit on a Hotel Rate Plans Reservation Stays Available
content:
How much of the credit standing on a Hotel Rate Plans reservation is available to spend turns on whether the handling date still falls inside the plan's validity term and on where the reservation record stands.

## The rule

1. Where the handling date is no later than the arrival date plus the credit validity term the rate plan booked carries and the reservation stands at checked in, 100 percent of the credit standing is available.
2. Where the handling date is later than the arrival date plus that validity term and the reservation stands at checked in, 0 percent of the credit standing is available.
3. In every other case 0 percent of the credit standing is available.

The term is counted in calendar days from the arrival date, and a handling date falling exactly on the last day of the term is no later than it.

## The validity term each plan carries

| Rate plan | Property credit validity from arrival, calendar days |
| --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | 0 |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | 0 |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | 0 |
| Standard Flexible Rate | 3 |
| Member Flex Rate | 5 |
| Suite Flexible Rate | 7 |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | 10 |

A plan carrying a term of 0 days admits only the arrival date itself.

## The combinations

| Handling date against the arrival date plus the plan's validity term | Reservation record stands at | Share of the credit standing available |
| --- | --- | --- |
| no later | checked in | 100 percent |
| later | checked in | 0 percent |
| no later | any other standing | 0 percent |
| later | any other standing | 0 percent |

## Worked on hypothetical figures

A credit standing of 150.00 USD on the Member Flex Rate, which carries a validity term of 5 calendar days, with an arrival date of the 10th:

- Handled on the 15th while the reservation stands at checked in, the handling date is no later than the 15th, and 100 percent is available, being 150.00 USD.
- Handled on the 16th while it stands at checked in, the handling date is later, and 0 percent is available, being 0.00 USD.
- Handled on the 12th while the reservation stands at checked out, 0 percent is available, being 0.00 USD.
